name: B10-0521/2026 (Verts/ALE) – Condemnation of pro-democracy activist and former lawmaker Au Kam San in Macao
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the condemnation of pro-democracy activist and former lawmaker Au Kam San in Macao
part_text:
**What this asks for**

This is not a law. It is the European Parliament's public statement of opinion. It condemns the 12-year-and-six-month prison sentence given to Au Kam San, a former lawmaker and pro-democracy activist in Macao, and calls for his release and for all charges to be dropped. It also asks Macao to respect free speech, association and peaceful protest, and asks the European Union to raise these cases with China.

**Key points**

- Nothing changes in law; Parliament only states its position and calls for Au Kam San's release.
- It affects Au Kam San, Macao's authorities, and European Union contacts with China.
- Next, the resolution is sent to the European Commission, the Council, China and Macao.
